name: Lake Oswego
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Lake Oswego, OR 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Lake Oswego, OR: Peppermint Bear at Lakewood Center, sensory-friendly Santa visits, the tree lighting and the Tinseltown Trolley.
lede: Lake Oswego rings in the season at Millennium Plaza Park the day after Thanksgiving, then fills December with trolley rides to see Santa, a breakfast puppet show for little ones and quiet Santa visits for children who need them.
celebrates: The City of Lake Oswego and the Lake Oswego Chamber of Commerce host the Tree Lighting Festival at Millennium Plaza Park, 200 1st Street, with a holiday marketplace, Winery Row, Timberview Farm reindeer, photos with Santa, letters to Santa with the Lake Oswego Police and music from high school show choirs and the Millennium Concert Band. The mayor leads the tree lighting. Lake Oswego Parks and Recreation also offers Sensory-Friendly Santa Visits at Christ Church Parish, and Lakewood Center for the Arts stages the Peppermint Bear show for ages 3 and up.
lastyear: The 61st Annual Tree Lighting Festival was planned for Friday, November 28, 2025, from 3 to 7 pm at Millennium Plaza Park, with the tree set to light at 5:30 pm. The City of Lake Oswego and the Chamber of Commerce presented it, and it was free. The festival has a holiday marketplace and photos with Santa, and the city's Parks and Recreation staff, police and fire crews work behind the scenes to run it.
facts: The Tree Lighting Festival has run for more than 60 years, and the Chamber's chief executive has described it as a Hallmark movie moment. The Millennium Concert Band that plays at the festival is made up of nearly 100 community members. The Willamette Shore Trolley's Tinseltown Trolley is operated by the trolley for Lake Oswego Parks and Recreation, and Santa boards at the end of the ride to greet riders as the trolley returns to the station. The Christmas Ships Trolley also collects unwrapped toys for local families in need.
trains: Lake Oswego's train story is the Willamette Shore Trolley, which leaves from the depot at 311 N. State Street. Its Tinseltown Trolley is a 45 minute holiday ride with lights, sweet treats, carols and a visit from Santa, and its Christmas Ships Trolley departs from Lake Oswego for a view of the lit boats. Tickets for both sell out quickly. TriMet's Line 35 bus links Lake Oswego with Portland City Center. In Portland, the Oregon Rail Heritage Center runs the Holiday Express steam train, and the Washington Park and Zoo Railway runs at the Oregon Zoo.

faq: Where is the Lake Oswego Christmas tree lighting?

The City of Lake Oswego and the Lake Oswego Chamber of Commerce hold the Tree Lighting Festival at Millennium Plaza Park, 200 1st Street, the day after Thanksgiving. It is free, with a holiday marketplace, Winery Row, Timberview Farm reindeer, Santa photos, letters to Santa and live music before the tree is lit.
Can kids write letters to Santa in Lake Oswego?

Yes. At the Tree Lighting Festival, the Lake Oswego Police Department helps children write letters to Santa. The festival also has photos with Santa, so families can visit the big man twice in one evening without leaving Millennium Plaza Park.

It is a holiday ride on the historic Willamette Shore Trolley, operated by the trolley on behalf of Lake Oswego Parks and Recreation. The ride lasts about 45 minutes, with holiday lights, sweet treats and carols, and Santa visits as the trolley returns. Tickets go on sale in August and sell out fast.
What is the Peppermint Bear show in Lake Oswego?

It is a 45 minute children's show by Lakewood Theatre Company on the Side Door Stage at Lakewood Center for the Arts, 368 S State Street. It is for ages 3 and up, and each performance includes a light continental breakfast. Doors open 20 minutes before each show.
Are there calm Santa visits in Lake Oswego?

Yes. Lake Oswego Parks and Recreation offers Sensory-Friendly Santa Visits at Christ Church Parish, 1060 Chandler Road, for children ages 0 to 12. Each family books its own 15 minute time slot in advance, which keeps the room quiet for children with sensory sensitivities or special needs.
Is there a train near Lake Oswego for kids?

Yes. The Willamette Shore Trolley departs from its depot at 311 N. State Street in Lake Oswego and runs vintage trips along the river. Portland's Oregon Rail Heritage Center runs the Holiday Express steam train in December. Check each operator for current dates and tickets.
